description: Delete an Inbox conversation from your own inbox. Other participants keep their copy. Cannot be undone. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

conversation_id.description: Inbox conversation ID (numeric string). Get it from list_conversations.

name: delete_conversation
title: Delete Conversation
